You can make out a fridge. The fridge is empty! What a waste of a day! You can make out a closed oven. You can see a table. The table is massive. But the thing hasn't got anything on it. Oh! There is a carrot, a red onion, a raw red potato, a raw purple potato and a block of cheese on the floor.
